verdict.rationale: The docs show a short path to an installed skill: a one-line global npm install, then `ultrametric init` (preview with `--dry-run`, then write the selected skill files) into Codex or Claude Code projects. These steps are spread across install and plugin pages rather than one end-to-end quickstart, and nothing supports the five-minute claim. Missing for 10: a single consolidated quickstart page, any time-to-first-skill claim or measurement, a documented sign-in/auth step within the flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the flow works quickly.
